state_and_clock.primitive_identity_rule: Exact D carrier identity only; no proton/neutron/Standard-Model correspondence is asserted.
state_and_clock.clock: tau_E := tau_D - tau_D,entry, dimensionless continuation of the parent intrinsic post-Big-Implosion clock; tau_E=0 at H_D_to_E entry.
state_and_clock.temperature_coordinate: Theta_E := Theta_D_final at the minimal-spine frozen-parent-bath approximation.

parent_constitutive_law.composite_energy_rule: For occupancy vector v in nonnegative integer^3, epsilon(v)=v^T M_C v. This is an internally dimensionless constitutive energy; it is not a measured nuclear mass.
parent_constitutive_law.binding_increment_rule: For an association v+w->v+w, B(v,w)=epsilon(v)+epsilon(w)-epsilon(v+w). Positive B is an internally bound channel; B<=0 is not admitted as a bound association at this fidelity.

species_derivation.candidate_rule: Start with the three protected primitive identities and close under positive-binding heterotypic association without duplicating a constituent identity beyond the minimal one-copy occupancy shell. This preserves every D primitive distinction and creates the smallest non-scalar composite family supported by the exact K3 interaction.

excluded_same_type_dimers.rule: For 2*e_i, binding increment = -4*a < 0, so same-type dimers fail the positive-binding admission witness at this fidelity.

reaction_hypergraph.reverse_routes: Exact inverse of every admitted forward route; no forward-only channel is allowed.

invariants.internal_charge_rule: The two independent primitive-count differences span the exact conserved internal charge space. No electric-charge correspondence is claimed.
invariants.baryon_correspondence: NOT_ASSIGNED; total_primitive_carrier is the source-owned precursor ledger at MINIMAL_SPINE.

rate_law.forward_coefficient: k_f=a for every elementary association; this is the unique no-new-coefficient complete-support specialization reusing the exact parent edge interaction timescale.
rate_law.reverse_coefficient: k_r(B)=a*exp(-B/Theta_E), using unit internal degeneracy at the minimal one-copy occupancy shell. This is the reversible canonical relation in the inherited dimensionless spectral coordinate; no Kelvin/MeV value or public rate table enters.

initial_state.rule: Map the exact H_D_to_E final primitive carrier distribution into E_X0,E_X1,E_X2 and initialize all newly opened composites at zero; no constituent is discarded or invented.

energy_memory_ledger.reaction_release: For each net forward route, positive B is transferred from U_E into RFL_E binding-memory ledger Q_E; reverse flow returns the same amount.
energy_memory_ledger.conservation_statement: U_E + Q_E is conserved by construction for the reaction subsystem when every forward/reverse route uses the same binding increment.

numerical_plan.stopping_rule: Integrate until max absolute reaction RHS < 1e-12 over the admitted species and verify persistence by a factor-two extension; t_end must be determined internally from the derived rates, not selected from a public nuclear timescale.
numerical_plan.max_step_rule: t_end/256 after t_end is internally established
numerical_plan.convergence: Repeat with max_step t_end/{64,128,256,512} and require finest-two final-state L_inf <=1e-8; repeat with rtol/atol tightened by 10 and require <=1e-8.
numerical_plan.network_convergence: Compare full six-association route family against each single-route withheld network; no withheld material route may be silently irrelevant above the declared 1e-8 output tolerance.

uncertainty.rule: For each parent decimal-envelope member, rederive a, M_C, D final state, composite energies, rates and E trajectory without retuning. Model uncertainty from the minimal one-copy composite-shell truncation is reported separately and is not fitted.

PUBLIC_BBN_IMPORT: insert proton/neutron/isotope labels, measured masses, lifetimes, cross sections or abundance targets; forbidden by generation seal.
NEW_FREE_RATE: replace a by an unconstrained kinetic coefficient; reject because the parent already owns the only admitted complete-support interaction timescale at this fidelity.
FORWARD_ONLY: remove reverse routes; reject because detailed balance and no-loss reopening fail.
SAME_TYPE_BINDING: admit 2*E_Xi as a bound species; reject because the exact parent constitutive binding increment is -4*a.
EDGE_WITHHELD: remove a lawful inherited heterotypic association lane; retain as required ablation and require a material trajectory change for any route classified material.
